purpose: Use the already-frozen UCDP GED 26.1 archive as an independent civilian-death measurement family for Nepal and Afghanistan without changing the historical violence confrontation.

source.processed_panel_note: The existing case processed UCDP CSVs omit deaths_civilians because they were built for the frozen violence task. Civilian-harm extraction therefore reads the hash-locked raw archive, not a reconstructed or model-conditioned value.

frozen_semantics.ucdp_definition: Best estimate of dead civilians in the event. In state-based/non-state events it records civilian collateral deaths from fighting; in one-sided violence it records civilians killed by side A.
frozen_semantics.numeric_uncertainty: No civilian-specific lower/upper interval is available from low/high total-fatality fields; do not copy total-fatality uncertainty onto deaths_civilians.

extraction_rules: Select only raw GED events whose country is the declared case and whose event interval overlaps the frozen case window.
Retain the raw UCDP event id, date_start, date_end, date_prec, where_prec, side_a, side_b, type_of_violence, source fields, and deaths_civilians.
Do not use best, low, or high total fatalities as civilian deaths.
Do not infer civilian injuries from deaths.
Do not use UCDP event count as a civilian-harm quantity.
Events with deaths_civilians equal to zero remain valid source records for extraction completeness but are not converted into positive harm claims.
No event is selected or excluded because of Pineland predictions, residuals, latent state, or whether it agrees with OHCHR/UNAMA.

annual_summary_rule.measure: sum of deaths_civilians for source events by case and calendar year within the frozen case window
annual_summary_rule.date_assignment: An event contributes to an annual numeric total only when its full UCDP date_start/date_end interval lies inside the case window and within one calendar year. Boundary-crossing or year-crossing intervals are retained event-level and flagged but not fractionally allocated or midpoint-imputed.
annual_summary_rule.partial_boundary_years: 2001 Nepal and 2021 Afghanistan are explicitly labeled partial-window years
annual_summary_rule.interpretation: Independent measurement series for civilian deaths, not ground truth and not a model scoring target.

overlap_crosscheck_rule.afghanistan: Compare UCDP annual civilian-death totals descriptively with same-calendar-period UNAMA/OHCHR totals where both are available; never tune or select years based on agreement.
overlap_crosscheck_rule.nepal: Use UCDP as an independent event-level civilian-death family. OHCHR's 2006 investigated-incident sample is not treated as population surveillance, so differences in totals are not interpreted as model or source failure.
metrics: annual count ratio where definitions/time windows match
Spearman annual rank correlation when at least four matched full years exist
exact-event concordance only when date/location identity is unambiguous
overlap_crosscheck_rule.no_success_threshold: This is a measurement-concordance diagnostic. No post-hoc numerical pass threshold is created from the observed source agreement.

limitations: UCDP and UN/OHCHR sources may sometimes cite overlapping underlying news or field reports; institutional coding systems are independent but raw-information dependence may remain.
deaths_civilians is a best estimate only and does not carry a civilian-specific numeric interval.
Differences in event inclusion, civilian classification, temporal precision, and verification standards are expected and must be preserved.
